name: Redman
description:
'''Reginald Noble''' (born April 17, 1970), better known by his stage name '''Redman''', is an American rapper and record producer. He rose to fame in the early 1990s as an artist on [[Def Jam Recordings]]. He is widely considered as one of the greatest rappers of all time within the hip hop culture.{{Citation needed|date=October 2026}}

He is well known for his collaborations with his close friend [[Method Man]], as one-half of the rap duo [[Method Man & Redman]] including their starring roles in films and sitcoms which include ''[[How High]]'' and ''[[Method & Red]]''.  He was also a member of the [[Def Squad]] in the late 1990s.
